objective: Create one materially stronger 茶作 wordmark structure without returning to texture tuning, font decoration, historical-style drift, or micro-coordinate polishing.

visual_authority.primary: Recovered V5 茶作 D mother pixels / 连笔一体

construction_route.name: MOTHER_ANCHORED_MACRO_STRUCTURAL_REAUTHORING
construction_route.base_topology: Do not inherit 149 path topology as authority
construction_route.raster_authority: Use V5 D mother silhouette/gesture as visual anchor
build_order: macro silhouette and two-character mass relationship
shared bridge and lower sweep as structural strokes
only then faithful vectorization if the raster/structural concept passes

five_high_leverage_variables.name: one_piece_gesture
five_high_leverage_variables.target: The pair must read as one authored moving composition, not two glyphs plus a connector.

five_high_leverage_variables.name: character_mass_hierarchy
five_high_leverage_variables.target: 茶 remains visibly broader/more active; 作 remains narrower/more upright. Equal-box balance is forbidden.

five_high_leverage_variables.name: dual_structural_coupling
five_high_leverage_variables.target: The mid bridge and lower sweep must emerge from the glyph construction itself and jointly bind the pair.

five_high_leverage_variables.name: stroke_mass_and_taper_rhythm
five_high_leverage_variables.target: Use deliberate alternation of blunt/heavy mass and directional taper; avoid uniformly smoothed vector weight.

five_high_leverage_variables.name: negative_space_tension
five_high_leverage_variables.target: The central and lower inter-glyph gaps must form active irregular shapes; spacing is designed as structure, not residual whitespace.

permitted_change.global_silhouette: YES, if still recognizably within the approved D family

forbidden: global decorative line added after the glyphs

human_gate.pass_definition: The single new black/ivory wordmark must show a clearly larger design-quality delta than 149 while remaining immediately readable and unmistakably related to the approved mother family.
